svg.title: parity-deriva · simple deployment (2 servers)
svg.desc: Server 1 runs archive, test and demo trading; server 2 runs real trading only. Strategies go from the archive to server 2 by push; MCP brings results and trade status back. The archive backs up with rclone. You + AI use MCP on both servers.
svg.text: archive, test and demo together; real trading on its own server
full access · strategies, indicators, results, trade status
AI: manages strategies and indicators, tunes parameters and the test algorithm, reads demo trades
archive and demo share the instance: strategies reach demo trading locally
strategy execution on the live account
AI reads the trade data, read-only
no access to the archive data
you + AI → MCP · real trade data, read-only
strategies, indicators, results · archive writes only
archive → demo / real, only by push
results, trade status, strategies to test
from archive only · S3, Drive, OneDrive…
one application, configured with a different role on each server
you + AI over MCP: archive (strategies, indicators), test (tuning), demo and real
demo and real always on separate servers, for performance and security
backup via rclone: S3, Google Drive, OneDrive or any remote; only the archive
one application · four roles · build, test, trade
